Fourier equidistribution applies for irrational traversal-time ratio, and the analytic band-edge locus has zero torus area. A two-to-one torus angle change followed by conditional integration gives (8/pi^2) integral_0^(pi/2) arcsin(k sin t)dt. Differentiation yields artanh(k)/k and the dilogarithm identity. Equal delays yield 2 asin(k)/pi; strict concavity gives the strict comparison. High-order coprime rational line measures converge by Fourier characters. Explicit low/high contrast series follow analytically. Independent matrix, quadrature and finite-frequency checks in verify.py passed 88 assertions. Boundary: limits are angular-frequency Lebesgue densities in the stated ideal model, not general density of states or finite-frequency uniform rates.

value.rationale: The global proportion of forbidden frequencies is an independently motivated broadband spectral observable for binary Bragg media, distinct from optimizing an individual gap. The theorem gives an exact universal formula and a sharp arithmetic design discontinuity, with nontrivial low- and high-contrast comparison laws; it is not a renamed transfer formula or a finite numerical table. It also identifies a concrete noncommutativity between the high-frequency and near-equal-travel-time limits. The narrow idealized assumptions and absence of finite-device guarantees are acknowledged.
